limitations: Known-value scan covers exact UTF8 literals only; no escaped, encoded, split, encrypted or transformed variants are claimed.
Only current workspace marker key and explicitly authorized Supabase password were loaded. Unknown local or Vercel-sensitive environment values were not read or scanned.

Only .next/static emitted client assets were scanned, including binary assets. Server bundles, rendered HTML/RSC payloads, API/network responses, public service workers and hosted deployments were not scanned.

Build association uses the existing successful frozen build receipt, BUILD_ID directory, asset timestamps and stable inventory at inspection. The build receipt did not itself pin these asset hashes at build time; this receipt is their first independent inventory.

Static source reachability follows relative import/reexport declarations, conservatively including type-only edges. It is not the compiler module graph; package dependencies, aliases, computed/dynamic imports and loaders are outside that graph claim.
No explicit server-only package guard was inferred from comments. Current source import boundaries and emitted-value/symbol absence do not certify every future refactor or unknown secret.
qualification: Narrow emitted-client and known-literal inspection, not hostile approval, complete secret audit, hosted verification or release completion.
